scheme_name: Nai Hetu Avashyak Upkaran Sahayata Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be a registered unorganized worker of the State Social Security Board.
Applicant must not be receiving any other parallel scheme of the state government.
benefits_summary: Provides registered barbers with a complete barber kit including scissors, straight razor, comb, hair‑cutting cape, water spray bottle, and shaving brush.
